technical_commentary: FACT's 24-month post-ATH range (Rs.1,133 Jun-2024 top) is not a clean Stage-4 decline: closing swing lows have genuinely risen (Rs.584.8 Apr-25 to Rs.662.1 Mar-26) and the 50/150/200-day lines have tangled (50>200>150) rather than staying bearishly stacked, even as swing highs keep slipping (Rs.1,026 to Rs.899) and the 200-day has net-declined for 6 straight months. It is a sloppy, wide-swinging range rather than a tightening base -- two ~30-44%-range monthly whipsaws (Apr-25, Mar-26) and no volatility contraction or higher-high breakout -- so this reads as an unconfirmed re-accumulation attempt inside a broad distribution top: correct the Stage label from '4-Declining' to Stage-3 basing-attempt, but not yet actionable as a template buy.
